name: AXM Evidence Chain Application Plan Foundry
actions: bind an accepted review assessment and decision to exact source and candidate JSONL
independently re-inspect the source and candidate before planning
require current-digest, safety-copy, fresh-permission, and no-authority acknowledgements
produce a time-bounded rollback-first operator plan with fixed stop conditions
name the still-missing executable Recovery Center adapter
summary: Builds a digest-bound, rollback-first, non-executable plan from an accepted evidence-chain recovery review without reading or changing live state.
notes: Plan-only and explicit-download-only. The Foundry does not read a live target, create a backup, check permission, stage, apply, roll back, restore history, recover a session, promote, or change CANON. Recovery Center integration remains an explicit missing adapter.
